hash_of: sha256 of the file with line endings normalised to LF. That is what was deployed: scripts/deploy.py reads the file with universal newlines, so the bytes on chain are LF whatever a Windows checkout with autocrlf put on disk.
why: Every published number is tied to this pair of addresses. verify.py lints the deployed bytes against these files, RESULTS.md and HELD-OUT.md name the instance they were measured on, and the refusal and rail transactions in the README were recorded against these contracts. A redeploy invalidates all of it and costs 63 consensus transactions to restore.
if_a_change_is_genuinely_required: python eval/run.py --set v2 --runs 3 --out eval/results-v2.json && python eval/report.py --results eval/results-v2.json --out eval/RESULTS-V2.md
update contracts/FROZEN.json, README addresses and every published number, in the same commit

v06.why: Studio Next runs this runtime. The first pair's runtime finishes invalid_contract runner malformed there whatever the file's first line says, and this runtime's standard library renamed five of the APIs the first pair uses.
v06.diff_is: The whole difference from the first pair: the runtime header, two imports, and five API names (gl.Contract, gl.get_contract_at, gl.vm.run_nondet_unsafe, gl.message_raw, and the emit stage "accepted", which consensus v0.6 calls "decided"). The logic, the prompt and every string are the first pair's. scripts/port.py generates both files and the diff from the first pair, and the gate regenerates them on every run.

deployments_note: Each deployment runs one of the two pairs recorded above and names it in `pair`; an entry that names none runs the first. The two pairs are the same logic, the same prompt and the same strings, with a published diff that touches only API names, under two runtimes, and both pairs of hashes are recorded here. Each network's evaluation is published in its own column.
deployments_status: Two deployments. studionet runs the frozen pair and Studio Next runs the v06 pair, deployed from commit 8daae5d. Every script refuses a network that has no entry here, by name.
